omnirush.ai

A desktop coding agent with free access to frontier models.

Website · Releases · CLI

--- omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects. GPT 6 Astra is the default model; GPT 6.1 Sol and the other models in your account's catalog are available from the model picker. ## Download Download the latest build from the [releases page](https://github.com/omnirush-ai/omnirush-gui/releases/latest).
